figure.title: Figure 11. Effect of thickness ratio and thickened root sections on the variation of drag coefficient at zero lift with Mach number for the wing-body configuration.
figure.x_axis: Mach number, M (labels '.4' to '1.2' under this panel). Grid every 0.05 from 0.40 (left frame) to 1.20 (right frame), 17 vertical lines about 96.6 px apart; labels every 0.1.
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient at zero lift, C_D0, lower panel scale. Grid every 0.005 from 0 (bottom frame) to 0.03 (top frame), 7 horizontal lines about 96.6 px apart; labels every 0.01.
figure.content_note: NACA faired curves only, no symbols, for wing 4 (47 deg sweep, thickened root) and wing 2 again (6 percent thick), each labelled with its wing number at both ends ('Wing 2 4' from top to bottom on the left, '4 2' from top to bottom on the right). Both curves start at M = 0.50 and end at about M = 1.122. Each is solid up to about M = 1.04, dashed from about M = 1.045 to about M = 1.085 (two dashes and gaps), then solid to its end. At subsonic speeds wing 2 is the upper curve and wing 4 the lower; they cross at about M = 0.93 and wing 4 is the higher one from there on. The NACA logo sits inside the panel at lower right, below the C_D0 = 0.005 line.
